images.name: 余烬·断衡
images.design: Crimson red COUNTERPOISE guillotine greatsword. A very massive asymmetrical tall continuous slab blade. Right edge ruler-straight, left cutting edge divided into exactly THREE enormous progressively offset angular cutting terraces, like three interlocking guillotine slopes rather than small saw teeth. Each terrace extends slightly farther left lower down, making blade shoulder-heavy, while top terminates in a long steep oblique chisel point. A single fine off-center vertical dark channel on broad face, no holes or floating blade fragments. Lower blade neck forms a strong triangular buttress. Guard is a compact asymmetric balance beam, long tapered wedge on left, short thick square counterweight on right, no traditional crossguard decoration. Long crimson grip, small low trapezoid pommel. Deep crimson faces, vermilion and coral lit bevels; sparse small red square cinders shed from the three steps. Monumental brutalist silhouette, thick strong sections. No circular cutout or moon motif.

images.name: 流萤·掠弧
images.design: Emerald green to mint SWEEP greatsword. ONE single elegant extremely long broad crescent-curved saber blade, continuously swept sideways in a long C curve from straight handle to needle-sharp tip. This is a huge two-handed sword, not scythe, axe, bow or staff: no transverse blade and no bowstring. Unbroken convex outer sharpened edge, concave inner spine, broad substantial lenticular cross-section. A smaller inset shallow crescent groove follows the sweep across its face without cutting through. Clean aerodynamic geometry, NO feather fins, NO repeated teeth, NO disconnected parts. Near the root the blade curls into a compact swept knuckle-wing guard extending to only one side, counterbalanced by a short droplet wedge on opposite side. Long straight two-handed dark jade luminous grip and clean angled capsule pommel. Saturated jade faces and turquoise/mint edge accents. A handful of short tiny curved green luminous motes follow outer edge; not a giant aura. Graceful asymmetric curved silhouette distinctly different from straight greatswords.

images.name: 寒汐·空阙
images.design: Cobalt to turquoise OPEN VAULT greatsword. A tall broad monumental hollow blade formed by TWO thick straight parallel sharpened side rails enclosing ONE extremely long narrow rectangular open window through 60% of the blade length. Blade outer width about 5 times grip width, each solid rail wide and thick, no fragile wire. Rails merge into a single solid pentagonal spear point at top and a broad solid stepped base at bottom. Exactly TWO stout staggered cross bridges connect rails inside window at different depth planes, creating a real architectural portal with readable negative space. No chain of rectangles, no circuit patterns, no bow shape. Squared U-shaped guard dips downward along either side of long usable straight grip, stepped geometric cuboid pommel. Deep ocean blue planes with bright cyan bevels, tiny rectangular blue light chips suspended in the long slot. Strong symmetric upright silhouette like an ancient geometric gate sharpened into a sword. No Z-shaped folds.

images.name: 梦隙·叠相
images.design: Violet to lavender FACETED PLEAT greatsword. A SINGLE very broad straight sword blade constructed as an extruded angular accordion cross-section, with exactly THREE longitudinal sharp faceted ridges and TWO deep folded valleys running almost full length. Show clearly sculptural planar origami depth in a slightly angled view: alternating broad violet faces catch light differently. Continuous solid blade, not three disconnected swords, not helical twist, not a drill, no holes. Outer edges taper gently into an exceptionally long elegant unified angular spear point, lower blade flares slightly like a fan before narrowing abruptly into hilt. Guard is a compact asymmetric pair of folded triangular planes like a geometric bow-tie bent in depth, not star, no wings. Long straight two-handed violet grip, small oblique flattened octahedron pommel. Deep plum/blue-violet faces with lavender and subtle pink-violet bevel light. A few tiny triangular prism motes float close to the two valleys, soft restrained glow. Distinct bold origami sculpture aesthetic.
